meta.name: Professional Motion Template Library Catalog
meta.note: Package names were checked against the npm registry. Versions are intentionally omitted; pin compatible versions in the project.

categories.styling: CSS, class composition, and component variants
categories.animation: UI, timeline, gesture, and physics animation
categories.text: Text splitting, wrapping, and animated numbers
categories.3d: WebGL rendering, helpers, effects, and asset optimization
categories.data: Data fetching, state, validation, and forms
categories.media: Images, video, Lottie, Rive, and asset preparation
categories.framework-adapter: Motion and 3D adapters for Vue and Svelte

libraries.name: Next.js
libraries.role: React framework with App Router, SSR, routing, and image optimization
libraries.notes: Use client components only around motion, browser APIs, and WebGL.

libraries.name: React
libraries.notes: Check peer ranges when adding R3F and motion packages.

libraries.name: Vue
libraries.notes: Use motion-v or @vueuse/motion instead of React motion packages.

libraries.name: Svelte
libraries.role: Compiled component runtime with built-in motion stores
libraries.notes: Use svelte/motion before adding another animation library.

libraries.name: Astro
libraries.role: Content-first framework with islands and view transitions
libraries.notes: Best for editorial, docs, and marketing sites with selective interactivity.

libraries.name: Vite
libraries.role: Fast SPA build tool for React, Vue, and Svelte
libraries.notes: Use when SSR and SEO are not primary requirements.

libraries.name: Nuxt
libraries.role: Vue framework with SSR, routing, and auto-imports
libraries.notes: Use motion-v and TresJS rather than React packages.

libraries.name: SvelteKit
libraries.role: Svelte framework with SSR and routing
libraries.notes: Use built-in svelte/motion and Threlte.

libraries.name: TypeScript
libraries.role: Static typing for component props, content models, and scene configs
libraries.notes: Use strict mode in templates.

libraries.name: Tailwind CSS
libraries.notes: Tailwind v4 uses CSS-first configuration; verify the project setup.

libraries.name: clsx
libraries.notes: Pair with tailwind-merge.

libraries.name: tailwind-merge
libraries.notes: Use in the cn() helper.

libraries.name: Class Variance Authority
libraries.notes: Use for buttons, badges, and other repeated primitives.

libraries.name: Lucide React
libraries.notes: Import icons individually; do not build an icon barrel file.

libraries.name: Lucide Vue
libraries.notes: Import icons individually.

libraries.name: Lucide Svelte
libraries.notes: Import icons individually.

libraries.name: next-themes
libraries.role: Light and dark theme switching for Next.js
libraries.notes: Only light and dark modes; avoid a third mode.

libraries.name: Motion (Framer Motion)
libraries.role: Declarative UI, layout, gesture, and scroll animation
libraries.notes: New package name; import from motion/react. framer-motion remains the compatibility package.

libraries.name: Framer Motion (compatibility)
libraries.role: Compatibility package for existing Framer Motion code
libraries.notes: Prefer motion for new projects; do not install both without a migration plan.

libraries.name: GSAP
libraries.role: Timeline animation, ScrollTrigger, and complex sequencing
libraries.notes: Use one GSAP context per component. Standard no-charge license; verify current plugin terms.

libraries.name: GSAP React
libraries.role: Official useGSAP hook with automatic cleanup
libraries.notes: Register useGSAP and ScrollTrigger once in a client module.

libraries.name: React Spring
libraries.notes: Use for physical, interruptible motion; not a GSAP replacement.

libraries.name: Anime.js
libraries.notes: Good for vanilla templates; check the v4 API before migrating.

libraries.name: AutoAnimate
libraries.role: One-line list and DOM transition animations
libraries.notes: Great for lists; not for choreographed scenes.

libraries.name: SplitType
libraries.role: Split text into lines, words, and characters
libraries.notes: Always revert splits on cleanup and keep accessible text.

libraries.name: React Wrap Balancer
libraries.notes: Use on short headings, not body copy.

libraries.name: NumberFlow
libraries.notes: Use for metrics and prices; provide a static fallback.

libraries.name: NumberFlow for Vue
libraries.notes: Use for metrics and prices; provide a static fallback.

libraries.name: NumberFlow for Svelte
libraries.notes: Use for metrics and prices; provide a static fallback.

libraries.name: Lenis
libraries.role: Smooth scrolling with native scroll preservation
libraries.notes: Use only when smooth scroll is part of the design; integrate with the GSAP ticker.

libraries.name: Three.js
libraries.role: WebGL renderer, scene graph, materials, and loaders
libraries.notes: Use dynamic import and dispose resources on unmount.

libraries.name: React Three Fiber
libraries.notes: Client-only; do not render Canvas in a server component.

libraries.name: Drei
libraries.role: Three.js helpers for loaders, controls, environment, and shadows
libraries.notes: Import only the helpers you use; some presets fetch remote assets.

libraries.name: R3F Postprocessing
libraries.role: Bloom, depth of field, noise, and other effects
libraries.notes: Desktop-first; measure GPU cost and provide a mobile fallback.

libraries.name: Postprocessing
libraries.role: Effect composer used by R3F postprocessing
libraries.notes: Peer dependency of @react-three/postprocessing.

libraries.name: Rapier
libraries.notes: Use only when interaction needs physics.

libraries.name: three-stdlib
libraries.notes: Avoid shipping the whole examples bundle.

libraries.name: glTF Transform
libraries.role: Optimize and inspect GLB and glTF assets
libraries.notes: Use in a build script, not in the browser.

libraries.name: Draco
libraries.notes: Decode on load; test startup cost on mid-range devices.

libraries.name: Meshoptimizer
libraries.notes: Alternative to Draco; verify loader support.

libraries.name: Matter.js
libraries.notes: Use for 2D play interactions; not a 3D engine.

libraries.name: tsParticles
libraries.notes: Easy to overuse; cap particles and pause offscreen.

libraries.name: Embla Carousel
libraries.notes: Preferred default; keyboard and touch support.

libraries.name: Embla Carousel for Vue
libraries.notes: Same Embla primitives with a Vue adapter.

libraries.name: Embla Carousel for Svelte
libraries.notes: Same Embla primitives with a Svelte adapter.

libraries.name: Swiper
libraries.notes: Use only when you need its features; bundle can grow.

libraries.name: Keen Slider
libraries.notes: Good alternative to Embla for simple cases.

libraries.name: Sonner
libraries.notes: Announce politely; do not rely on color alone.

libraries.name: Vue Sonner
libraries.notes: Use a polite live region and do not rely on color alone.

libraries.name: Svelte Sonner
libraries.notes: Use a polite live region and do not rely on color alone.

libraries.name: Vaul
libraries.notes: Use with focus management and keyboard support.

libraries.name: cmdk
libraries.notes: Trap focus and support keyboard shortcuts.

libraries.name: TanStack Query
libraries.role: Server state, caching, and async UI states
libraries.notes: Use for app templates, not static marketing pages.

libraries.name: Zustand
libraries.notes: Use for UI state; do not duplicate server state.

libraries.name: Zod
libraries.notes: Validate forms and API payloads.

libraries.name: React Hook Form
libraries.notes: Pair with zod through @hookform/resolvers.

libraries.name: Hook Form Resolvers
libraries.role: Zod and Yup resolvers for React Hook Form
libraries.notes: Only install when using a schema resolver.

libraries.name: Recharts
libraries.notes: Use for dashboards and simple analytics; customize tokens to match the theme.

libraries.name: Visx
libraries.notes: Use when Recharts cannot express the chart; import only the packages you need.

libraries.name: D3
libraries.notes: Prefer specific d3 submodules if the full bundle is too large.

libraries.name: Sharp
libraries.role: Image resizing and format conversion at build time
libraries.notes: Generate AVIF/WebP and blur placeholders.

libraries.name: Plaiceholder
libraries.notes: Use at build time and cache the result.

libraries.name: BlurHash
libraries.notes: Decode small strings; useful with CMS images.

libraries.name: Rive React
libraries.notes: Keep .riv assets small; provide a reduced-motion fallback.

libraries.name: Lottie React
libraries.notes: Avoid large JSON files; lazy-load and pause offscreen.

libraries.name: Theatre.js Core
libraries.notes: Advanced; use when designers need a timeline editor.

libraries.name: Theatre.js Studio
libraries.notes: Development only; never ship the studio bundle.

libraries.name: Leva
libraries.role: Debug controls for scene and motion parameters
libraries.notes: Development only; strip from production builds.

libraries.name: Playwright
libraries.role: End-to-end browser tests and visual checks
libraries.notes: Test reduced motion, keyboard navigation, and the no-WebGL fallback.

libraries.name: Vitest
libraries.notes: Use jsdom or happy-dom for component tests.

libraries.name: axe-playwright
libraries.notes: Automated checks do not replace manual testing.

libraries.name: Next Bundle Analyzer
libraries.notes: Run before and after adding motion or 3D.

libraries.name: Barba.js
libraries.role: Page transitions for server-rendered multi-page sites
libraries.notes: Use when the site is not an SPA and needs page transitions.

libraries.name: Swup
libraries.notes: Good for static sites; test script re-initialization.

libraries.name: Motion for Vue
libraries.notes: Use instead of React motion packages.

libraries.name: VueUse Motion
libraries.notes: Good for declarative enter and leave transitions.

libraries.name: TresJS
libraries.notes: Vue equivalent of React Three Fiber.

libraries.name: TresJS Nuxt
libraries.notes: Adds auto-imports and Nuxt integration.

libraries.name: Threlte
libraries.notes: Svelte equivalent of React Three Fiber.

libraries.name: Astro React
libraries.notes: Required if you want Motion or React Three Fiber inside Astro.

libraries.name: Lenis (legacy package)
libraries.notes: Replace with the lenis package.

libraries.name: Locomotive Scroll
libraries.notes: Prefer Lenis with GSAP ScrollTrigger for new work.
